reviews.text: We vacation a lot and Trace is always available to take care of our two kitties. We love seeing the daily pictures and updates he sends.

Every time I travel I know my cat, Lucy, is in good hands with Trace. He's reliable, communicative, and takes the extra step in caring for her. Lucy never comes out because she's so afraid of everything, but he manages to snap a pic at every visit to let me know she's OK. I'm so grateful to have Eastside Petsitters as a support system!

Eastside Petsitters are wonderful! I have been using their services for my cats for over three years. They are very reasonably priced and extremely reliable. Trace Oakley always sends pictures and updates daily which I look forward to always. Highly recommend!

We love Eastside Petsitters! My husband and I travel often and always feel good about leaving our cat Bagel in Trace’s care. He always looks happy and healthy as ever when we return and Trace sends us great photo updates every day. Thank you, Trace and Eastside Petsitters!!

We’ve trusted Trace at Eastside Pet Sitters for years and couldn’t recommend him more highly. He takes excellent care of Clyde and provides thoughtful daily updates that give us total peace of mind. Communication is always smooth and reliable—both with scheduling and throughout our time away from home.

Meg and Trace are the sweetest. Right off the bat, they were both so warm and knowledgeable, I immediately felt my worries about leaving my dogs home melt away. Both my home and dogs were so well taken care of! I’m so thankful I found them and happy to spread their name to friends and family :) Lovelovelove all the photos and updates they send per visit as well

I have used Eastside Petsitters for decades now and they are the absolute best. They're so very caring and so very loving of my cats. I feel like they are members of the family. Recently, I was away when the unthinkable happened, and I was very relieved to have Meg there to take care of things the way that I would have. Cannot recommend enough. The best.
I have been with Eastside Petsitters for the past 12 years!  They are the best!  My two rescue dogs are safe and in loving hands!  I highly recommend Meg and her team!!!!!

Trace from East Side Petsitters is the best! He has taken such wonderful care of our cats whenever we are away for years now. We always look forward to his texts checking in each visit along with photos. The cats appreciate it too, they love his visits & hate to travel. I can’t recommend East Side Petsitters highly enough! 5 enthusiastic stars

Trace has been caring for my cats since 2013. I would trust no one else with them. His attention to detail and reliability are unprecedented. All of my instructions for their care are followed perfectly. He sets up their special blanket fort, brushes them, and knows which doors in the house should be left closed. I have peace of mind knowing Eastside Petsitters are there when I am not.

I found Eastside Petsitters back in 2011 when I was looking for someone to take care of my diabetic cat.  Trace was Alistair’s petsitter for years, giving him insulin shots twice a day.  I knew Alistair was in good hands and I continue to trust Trace to take care of my current kitties.  He’s caring, reliable and responsive.  I appreciate the picture updates.  Strongly recommend Eastside Petsitters and Trace!
Meg is amazing! It's such a relief to know our pup is in such good hands when we're away!

I have trusted Trace at Eastside Petsitters to care for my beloved now 15 y/o kitty for a decade. My boy can be *spicy* and is not an easy cat at times. Trace has always been so patient and kind with him, he’s a true animal lover. I really appreciate the daily photo updates as well. Very reliable, and their services are affordable. I highly recommend!

Would highly recommend Eastside Petsitters! Trace has taken care of my two dogs many times for extended periods while I've been out of town, and he's always responsive, helpful, and clean. Thank you, Eastside!

Trace has been taking care of our two cats since they were kittens (8 years now!) and we're so thankful for him! He's super reliable, responsive, and we love the daily photo updates while we're away. Wouldn't leave them with anyone else - thanks, Trace!

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Meg. She cared for my cats for more than 15 years, and the peace of mind she gave me during that time is priceless. My cats absolutely adored her, always feeling safe, comfortable, and happy in her care.

When one of my cats had a medical emergency while I was traveling, she immediately stepped in, rushed him to the pet hospital, and made sure he was in excellent hands. I will never forget her calm, decisive response and the compassion she showed during one of the most stressful situations of my life. She went above and beyond.

She treated my fur babies like her own, and that level of trust is something you can’t put a price on. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a responsible, loving, and truly exceptional pet sitter.

Meg has been my petsitter for over 4 years now. I'm so lucky to have found her services! She takes great care of my 2 kitties when I'm out of town and I always feel safe and confident that they're in the best hands! When my cat Pumpkin had a medical issue right as I had to leave town, I was very nervous, but Meg went above and beyond and took great care to clean his wound and ensure he was healing and healthy when I returned. She sends me a ton of pictures of my kitties that gives me great peace of mine when I'm away. Thanks, Meg!
Excellent, friendly, reliable service. Trace at Eastside Petsitters has cared for our cats for over a dozen years with no issues. We're so thankful for him!

Trace took care of my elderly cats beautifully while I was away, including feeding, giving them meds, cleaning up their whoopsies and spending time with them. I had never hired a petsitter service before but I felt very comfortable with them in his care.
Trace is amazing , very responsive, loves pets and is very reliable. i've been using him for years!

I cannot say enough good things about Trace from Eastside Petsitters! Our male cat is definitely a handful. Trace is so reliable, very responsive, and able to give my cat his meds in a way that I even struggle with. I used worry about leaving my cat when I was out of town, but having Trace take care of him has greatly lessened my stress. I'm very grateful to Trace & the Eastside Petsitters team! Incredible photo updates as well!

Daisy my dog loves Meg as much as me.  She is the only pet sitter I would trust with my dog and cat.  We adore how kind and considerate Meg is and she just loves animals!!!!! Do yourself a favor and trust Eastside Pet Sitters with all of your pet needs.  Meg is also so amazing with cats. I have never ever seen a better lover of cats in my life and she treats all animals in the highest regard.  They are her world.  Thank you Meg!  We love you
